name: Route M arithmetic first-moment coefficient kappa_arith
statement: F_arith(b) = kappa_arith phi(b) b + E1-type remainder with kappa_arith = (3/2)C - 3/8 = 0.5704960511, C = (log 2pi - gamma)/2; arithmetic leaf of the first moment F(b) = Sum_{(a,b)=1} I(a,b) of the Vasyunin/Nyman-Beurling Gram coefficients.

name: Vasyunin two-variable coefficient I(a,b)
statement: I(a,b) = C(a+b) + (1/2)(a-b) log(b/a) - (pi/2)(V(a,b)+V(b,a)), V(a,q) = Sum_{m=1}^{q-1} frac(ma/q) cot(pi m/q), C = (log 2pi - gamma)/2. Entries of the Nyman-Beurling/Baez-Duarte Gram form; Q(b) = Sum_{(a,b)=1} I(a,b)^2/a^2 is the interior second moment.

name: Route M full first-moment constant kappa -> 0.69550
statement: kappa(b) = F(b)/(phi(b) b) re-measured on primes b=101..8009 declines smoothly to 0.69550, window std 6e-5, consistent with (3/2)C - 1/4 = 0.695496, i.e. kappa_cot = 1/8. Per-part positivity fails at b=30; only the sum is robustly positive.

name: Route M first moment is a mean-value statement (obstruction map P15)
statement: The first-moment programme gives F(b) >= b phi(b)/2 - 1, Int(N) >= (36K^2/pi^2) log N - O(1), K = 0.6954960511, lam_max(G_N) <= 18: mean-value statements only, nothing about lam_min, d_N or zeros; a Davenport-Heilbronn analogue exists.

name: Uniform remainder for the coprime log sum L0(b)
statement: For L0(b) = Sum_{1<=a<b,(a,b)=1} log a: |E0(b)| <= (1/2) log b + (1/2) log 2pi + 11/8 + (1/6) sigma(b)/b for all b >= 2, with exact decomposition E0(b) = (1/2) Lambda(b) - (1/2)(Moebius-moment terms); no 2^omega(b) prefactor.

name: Per-divisor identity for the weighted coprime sum remainder E1(b)
statement: E1(b) = L1(b) - phi(b) b((1/2) log b - 1/4), L1 = Sum_{(a,b)=1} a log a, satisfies E1(b) = Sum_{d|b} mu(d) C_d exactly (Glaisher-Kinkelin collapse), with leader mu(b) b/4 plus inward correction Delta(b) = mu(b) b Sum_{e|b,e>1} mu(e) h(e).

name: b/4 ceiling |E1(b)| <= b/4 is false for general squarefree b
statement: |E1(b)| <= b/4 holds on omega(b) <= 3 (proved) and 0 violations for b <= 20000, but fails: explicit squarefree windows of primes from P0 = 379 and P0 = 101 give T(b) < -1/4 (exact segmented sieve). Does not affect kappa_arith.

name: Multiplicative complete monotonicity (MCM) fails at omega = 11
statement: Hypothesis: every iterated multiplicative difference of h = g/m over a finite prime set is non-negative. Holds for omega <= 10 (primorial margins 1.00e-2 .. 4.78e-4), first fails at the 11-primorial (-9.62e-4). Decrement law dS = -(Pi_omega/p_{omega+1})(A_omega + c log p_{omega+1}).

name: MCM bracket limit B_inf = ln A + gamma/12
statement: The Route M MCM bracket limit is B_inf = ln(Glaisher A) + gamma/12 = 0.2968557824, from lim(log p_omega - Sum_{p<=p_omega} log p/(p-1)) = gamma; gap law gap(omega) ~ e^{-gamma} B_inf / log p_omega. Verified by sieve to 5e7.

name: Gap-law residual changes sign repeatedly along the prime ladder
statement: residual(omega) = gap(omega) - e^{-gamma} B_inf/log p_omega at dps 35-40 has eight sign changes on the ladder to p ~ 4.93e8; local decay exponent oscillates with a widening envelope (average ~10.2-10.6); magnitude correlates with the Mertens error delta at common heights.

name: Liouville/Moebius parity sign law of the first-moment residual
statement: r(b) = F_arith(b)/(phi(b) b) - kappa_arith is the equidistribution discrepancy of psi over coprime residues; Moebius inversion gives sign r(b) = (-1)^omega(b) at leading order (von Mangoldt coefficient 1/4); at primorials P5..P8 a subleading Moebius term takes over.

name: First-moment residual magnitude governed by smallest prime factor
statement: Geometric mean |r(b)| rises about 3x from P^-(b) = 2 (1.35e-5) to the near-prime plateau; two-descriptor model log|r| ~ a0 + a_w omega + a_P log P^-(b) has in-sample R^2 0.850 and holds out of sample.

name: Sign law T(b) < 0 for squarefree b
statement: T(b) = Sum_{e|b,e>=2} mu(e) J(e-1) (J the Binet remainder) satisfies T(b) = -J(p1-1) + Sum_{e|m,e>1} mu(e) D_{p1}(e). Proved negative for omega <= 4; omega = 5 reduced to two explicit inequalities with tail threshold Q0 = 7; weighted level-domination fails for large omega.

name: Friable Mertens sup bound sup_t |M_k(t)| = o(p_k) is false
statement: For M_k the Moebius partial sum over p_k-friable squarefree integers with dilation recursion M_k = (I - D_{p_k}) M_{k-1}: sup_t |M_k(t)| ~ 1.71^k, sup/p_k crosses 1 near k = 13. Any o(1) tail must come from signed t-integration, not a sup majorant.

name: Mertens cap Qlog(b) <= e^{-gamma} is false
statement: Qlog(b) = prod_{p|b}(1-1/p) Sum_{p|b} log p/(p-1)-type term is unbounded: b = 5*7*11*13*17*19 gives |Qlog| = 0.780 > 0.5615; add-a-prime identity F(P u {p}) - F(P) = (prod_P/p)(log p - S(P)); over primes in (y,x] the value grows like log y.

name: Varying-modulus Vasyunin half converges to -1/(4 pi)
statement: Sum_{a=2,(a,b)=1}^{b-1} V(b,a)/(phi(b) b) converges to -0.07958, matching -1/(4 pi) = -0.0795775 to about 5 digits past b ~ 12870; implies kappa_cot = +1/8. V(b,a) = V(b mod a, a); creep ~ C/b.

name: Sign of the signed cotangent half S(b) < 0
statement: S(b) = Sum_{a=2,(a,b)=1}^{b-1} V(b,a) is measured negative but unproved. Kernel is odd and mean-zero: c_0(h/a) = -c_0((a-h)/a). Exact residue-resonance form S(b) = Sum_{r>=1} Sum_{a|(b-r), r<a<b} c_0(r/a); small-r family dominance refuted (each family O(d(b-r) b log b)).

name: Signed-to-absolute cotangent cancellation ratio 0.540
statement: |S(b)|/A(b), A(b) = Sum |c_0(h_a/a)| with h_a = b^{-1} mod a, settles in a 0.4% band around 0.5397 for 4001 <= b <= 24001; absolute downside coefficient A(b)/(phi(b) b) plateaus (measured c_1 ~ 0.29 < kappa_arith).

name: Inverse-line second moment M2w = DIAG + OFFDIAG (Kloosterman-type)
statement: Character detection writes the inverse-line cotangent second moment exactly as M2w * Sum_a a = DIAG + OFFDIAG, DIAG = Sum_a phi(a) E_h[(c_0/a)^2]; OFFDIAG/DIAG stays about 0.86 (co-leading) to b = 1201; factorisation M2w = Rw * Mbar; oversampling OVR(b) -> ~1.25.

name: Cauchy-Schwarz reduction of the absolute cotangent first moment to M2w
statement: c_1 <= sqrt(M2w): the absolute first moment over the inverse line is bounded by the a-weighted mean square; measured sqrt(M2w) ~ 0.415 < kappa_arith = 0.5705. Certification needs the Bettin-Conrey second moment transferred to the inverse line a -> b^{-1} mod a.

name: Small-inverse frequency is a divisor sum
statement: #{a < b, (a,b)=1 : b^{-1} mod a <= H} <= Sum_{h<=H} d(bh - 1): the count of moduli with small inverse needs no Kloosterman input. Termwise bound |c_0(h/a)| <= K (a/h) log 2a fails in the bulk h ~ a/2.

name: Fixed-a asymptotic of I(a,b)
statement: For fixed a, I(a,b) = (a/2) log b + d_a + o(1) with d_a = (a/2)(2C + 1 - log a); hence I(a,b)/a = (1/2) log(b/a) + C + 1/2 + o(1) and the fixed-a moment Sum_a kappa_a^2/a^2 diverges (each term 1/4).

name: Bulk profile of the Vasyunin coefficient
statement: I(xb, b) = b f(x) + o(b), f(x) = C(1+x) + (1/2)(1-x) log x - (pi/2) w(x), w(x) = lim (V(xb,b) + V(b,xb))/b the cotangent-sum limit; curvature of f equals that of w; crossover fraction x*(eps) is b-independent to 3-4 digits.

name: Interior second moment Q = Qhat + Qcross + Qrr
statement: With Ihat = (a/2) log(b/a) + a(C+1/2) and r = I - Ihat, Q(b) splits in the 1/a^2-weighted l^2 product; leading slope s0 = lim Q(b)/b ~ 1.76-1.79; sub-leading term is log^2 b with a coefficient that is an arithmetic function of b (Moebius collapse).

name: Sub-leading constant cQ of Q(b) is not determinable from the ladder
statement: sqrt(b) and log^2 b sub-leading models stay collinear on the exact Q(b) ladder to b = 16000 (checked to 1e5); three decorrelation designs fail; joint fits give s0 = 1.7871, cQ = -2.008 versus constant-model cQ ~ -13.4.

name: Bettin-Conrey reciprocity residual does not decay along the Gauss map
statement: w_sym(a,q) = (V(a,q)+V(q,a))/q depends only on the reduced rational. After one reciprocation the residual is another cotangent sum of the same shape; along Gauss-map orbits its RMS stays ~0.026. Gauss-Kuzmin averaging isolates kappa_smooth < 1e-2 only as x -> 0.

name: w_lin from the Estermann double pole
statement: The Laurent block {A, B, C0} of the Estermann function at its s = 1 double pole reproduces the linear part of w(x): log(x)/pi from the double-pole residue and 2C/pi from the finite part, with kernel gamma factor N(s) = (2 pi)^{-s} Gamma(s).

name: Cusp coefficient kappa_smooth of the Bettin-Conrey period function
statement: kappa_smooth = O(x^2) Taylor coefficient of psi at the cusp = (pi/2)[P2 - L2], P2 a zeta(2) Eisenstein-period part, L2 a gamma_1 double-pole part; reflection weight W_refl is not computed. Weight-2 period polynomial has degree 0 and cannot carry z^2.

name: Boundary cotangent sum V(1,b)
statement: V(1,b) = c_0(1/b) = Sum_{m=1}^{b-1} (m/b) cot(pi m/b) has sub-leading coefficient -pi/36 (Euler-Maclaurin with singular endpoint, digamma cross-check); boundary leg -V(1,b)/(phi(b) b) -> 0.

name: Arithmetic cotangent resonances at x = 1/6 and 1/5
statement: The signed deviation (I - I_lin)/I has adjacent crests at x = 1/6 and 1/5; the 1% crossing of the 1/6 crest is an alignment band set by b mod 6, not a single b.

name: Route M conditioning-ceiling band
statement: Ordered ceiling band for the Gram conditioning: trace 2.594e7 < Frobenius-rigorous 3.748e7 < concave-tail 3.838e7 < concave-quad 4.088e7 < measured 4.109e7; exact ladder extended to N = 24000 widens the quad-to-measured margin to 0.518%.

name: Pole-free Weil symbol sigma_2 and residual w_1
statement: sigma_2(t) = (t^2 + 1/4)^2 w_1(t), w_1(t) = 2 theta'(t) - sqrt2 ln2 cos(t ln 2) (archimedean phase derivative minus the p = 2 term). Pole-free Weil positivity on support 2a is T_a[sigma_2] = P_a M_{sigma_2} P_a >= 0 on PW_a.

name: Krein concentration constant c_sharp at 2a = ln 3
statement: c_sharp = lambda_min(P_a M_{sigma_2} P_a) at 2a = ln 3: coupled N,T Rayleigh-Ritz extrapolation gives ~0.582 (range [0.5817, 0.5842]); fixed-T column 0.5811 -> 0.5786 for N = 84..164; a separate nested-basis ladder suggests ~0.45. All are upper brackets; no positive lower bound is certified.

name: Certified positive lower bound on c_sharp at ln 3
statement: Needed: P_a M_{sigma_2} P_a >= c I with c > 0 at 2a = ln 3. Rigorous floors so far are negative: bathtub -3065.435, reproducing-kernel -3200.029, well depth -4336.198. Lehmann-Maehly and de Branges coercivity both reduce to one PW_a concentration inequality against the confined negative well.

name: Negativity set of sigma_2 is one confined well; far field positive
statement: sigma_2 < 0 only on W = [0, 3.306] u [6.945, 10.532] and its mirror (depth -4336 at t = 9.35); rigorous positivity for t >= 27 (crossing t* = 26.1023, margin 0.0616) and guarded margin +8.114 on [10.532, 27].

name: Positive/negative symbol split loses the band-limited cancellation
statement: Bound Q(g) >= lambda_min(T_a[sigma^+]) - lambda_max(T_a[sigma^-]) crosses zero at 2a = 0.6026 < ln 2 while true lambda_min there is 1.59 to 6.42. A well-concentrated and far-field-depleted |ghat|^2 cannot be one PW_a element; only the correlation-preserving LP/Krein certificate (verified to 2a <= 0.96) keeps the cancellation.

name: Zero crossing of lambda_min(T_a[sigma_2]) drifts down to ln 3
statement: Crossing 2a*(N): 1.13052, 1.12543, 1.12025, 1.11046, 1.10033 for N = 20, 28, 36, 44, 52 (ln 3 = 1.098612), margin +0.032 -> +0.0017 with non-shrinking steps. Just above ln 3 a p = 2 resonance eigenvalue falls from +0.47 to below -6 within 0.005 in 2a.

name: Bathtub joint floor for band-limited forms
statement: For psi in PW_a with unit norm, |psi|^2 <= a/pi pointwise and has unit mass, so int sigma_2^- |psi|^2 <= (a/pi) int over the deepest measure-(pi/a) sub-level set = 3065.435 at 2a = ln 3; hence c_sharp >= -3065.435. Realisable fraction about 44-51% (R = 1343.8 to ~1573).

name: Standard concentration inequalities give no positive c_sharp
statement: Beurling-Selberg minorants (circular: a type-2a minorant restates truncated-Toeplitz positivity), flat prolate/Slepian eigenvalues, Donoho-Stark, Turan/Amrein-Berthier, Nazarov, weighted-PSWF decay (signed split caps at <= 0), Temple/Kato-Temple and Lehmann-Maehly (need a-priori lambda_2 bound) all fail to give c > 0 at 2a = ln 3.

name: Fejer-Riesz square with margin exists iff c <= c_sharp
statement: (t^2+1/4)^2 = |(t - i/2)^2|^2 is a free Hermitian square reducing sigma_2-coercivity to w_1-coercivity on h = (-D^2 + 1/4) g modulo boundary terms; w_1(0) = -6.352. A truncated (Mercer) square with margin c exists iff c <= c_sharp: restatement, not a bound.

name: Bare residual w_1 negative on [0, 3.305) and at t = ln 3
statement: w_1 is negative on the whole leading interval [0, 3.30501) and at t = ln 3; negative-to-positive mass ratio over the resolution window grows past the verified reach. No pointwise or symbol-level argument can give positivity near ln 3.

name: Certified spherical-Bessel z^-4 tail constant for the Krein tail integral
statement: For the ground combination g(t) = v0 . Phih(t) = a^7 Sum_k d_k j_k(a t) with annihilated t^-1, t^-2, t^-3 coefficients, an interval-certified z^-4 remainder constant C = 45504.154 bounds the Rayleigh tail; Gegenbauer C_n^{13/2}-Legendre overlaps c_jk computed in exact rationals (band k <= j+6, parity j+k even).

name: Degree-to-v0 overlap inversion blocks the annihilating-trial certificate
statement: Exact integer degree-level annihilating trials (e.g. (33,55,27,5)) cannot be mapped back to the committed ground vector v0 through d = C^T v0 with interval enclosure; the remainder envelope is complete, the inversion step remains open.

name: Toeplitz/Weil support ladder past ln 3 (obstruction map P19)
statement: All-support positivity at damping theta is equivalent to the half-plane 1/2 + theta; finite-support rungs at theta = 0 have model margins of order 1e-30900. Finite-support Weil positivity near ln 3 uses only p = 2 (one in-band prime harmonic) and restates verified-height information.

name: Reproducing-kernel floor is linear in the band half-width
statement: floor(a) = -(a/pi) int sigma_2^-(t) dt measured across 2a <= 0.96: the scalar floor scales linearly in a because the confined well is band-independent; the scalar two-budget coupling is exhausted.

name: Well capture versus far-field cost for band-limited minimisers
statement: For the confinement family with taper g(xi) = (1 - (xi/a)^2)^2 exp(-(R xi)^2/2), the minimum of int sigma_2 |psi|^2 is 6.56 -> 7.22 tail-converged at R* ~ 3.36, about 12x the Ritz floor; far-field bias relBias(R) = 3(1/a - a R^2)(I2/I1) changes sign at R = 1/a.

name: Step-4 bridge |Lambda - (-t_c(N))| <= E(N)
statement: E(N) = E_coll + E_trunc + E_flow bounds the gap between Lambda and the N-particle backward-flow first-collision time; Lambda <= -t_c + E(N), so the bridge needs a lower bound on t_c. Open at the Holder-1/2 shock modulus C_H; E(N) -> 0 is not supplied.

name: Conditional share sigma(N) = E_coll/E(N) landmark ladder
statement: In the component model sigma has an interior maximum 0.949429 at N ~ 9.22e5, falls below 0.9 at N ~ 2.57e7, halves near the closed-form N_cross = (C_C/E_trunc)^2-type crossover, and decays with local exponent rising to 1/2. E_coll is the largest term for all N <= 1.6e6.

name: sigma(N) peak-then-decay moves no unconditional bound
statement: The collision term carries the many-body constant C_mb <= 1, known only under GUE universality; the search for an unconditional bound (Selberg, Huxley, GGM approaches) failed. A tighter C_mb lowers the peak and does not move N_max. No handle on E(N) -> 0 follows.

name: Three-axis elasticity additivity E_CC + E_ET + E_CF = 0
statement: sigma = E_coll/E_N is degree-0 homogeneous in the amplitudes (C_C, E_trunc, C_F), so the crossing elasticities sum to zero exactly; pair ratio E_CF/E_ET = E_flow/E_trunc; the Gronwall exponent axis obeys E_GEXP = TC_A1_TRAP * E_CF and breaks four-axis additivity.

name: Square-root fold at the sigma peak
statement: Near the peak sigma = sigma_max - A dx^2, so C_C-elasticity diverges with amplitude K = sqrt(sigma_max(1 - sigma_max)/(2 phi_xx)) = 0.423330; kernel |1/(N sigma_N)| grows by sqrt(10) per decade; the fold disappears in a saddle-node at floor factor 56.9184 (N* ~ 456).

name: Far-tail sigma exponent equals the Riemann-von Mangoldt slope
statement: Diagnostic (1/2 - p) * 2 log T0 = (1 - sigma)(1 - 1/log(T0/2 pi)) + sigma log T0 deep in the tail: the residual to exponent 1/2 is the log-derivative of the zero-counting density at effective height T0(N).

name: E_trunc tail exponent with Guth-Maynard zero density
statement: At sigma = 3/4 the Guth-Maynard exponent (30/13)(1 - s) = 15/26 improves on Ingham for the truncation tail; the prefactor is not pinned. E_trunc_pt = 3.06e-5 above T = 3e12 (Ingham), about 6500x below the 0.2 budget, so the improvement does not change Lambda <= 0.2.

name: Explicit E_flow at N* = 1e4
statement: E_flow = (C_F L/T0) exp(C_G |t_c|) = 1.239487e-3 with Gronwall constant C_G = 2/y_*^2 = 2 (y_* >= 1) away from collision, exponent <= 4.74e-4.

name: Palm two-slot mirror count trails its mean by 1/y0
statement: Neutral rigid lattice, spacing 2 pi/ln N, mirror kernel 2[2y/(D^2+4y^2)], y0 = 0.165: palm2(ln N) = ln N/2 - 1/y0 + o(1), 1/y0 = 6.0606, so frac = 1 - (400/33)/ln N; 0.5345 at ln N = 22, 0.9879 at ln N = 1000.

name: First-collision time modulus is exactly Holder-1/2
statement: The collision-time map has Holder exponent exactly 1/2, from the inverse-square-root cusp density of the limiting shock measure; no finite Lipschitz constant exists, which is the analytic source of the C_Lip divergence.

name: cond-polymath15-G6a equals cond-CH
statement: The asymptotic Polymath15 bridge modulo G6a and the finite-N E_coll conditional are the same object: the Holder-1/2 shock modulus C_H. Every Lambda statement from the Route B flow result passes through this one conditional.

name: Gronwall integral int 2/g^2 diverges at collision
statement: The collision-stopped surrogate I_eps(g0) = (1/2) log(g0/eps) is finite for eps > 0 and diverges as eps -> 0; the cusp rate g_min ~ C_shock W_1^{1/2} cannot rescue the window [t_c - delta, t_c]. C_Lip in the W_1 channel is not boundable.

name: Theta-trap contraction constant is N-uniform
statement: C_Theta <= 24 + 16 Theta <= 28 from one termwise inequality valid for every N and every adjacent pair; realised constant ~4.35, flat in N. The resulting rigorous bound on t_c has the wrong sign for Lambda (Lambda <= -t_c + E(N) needs a lower bound on t_c).

name: Uniform field bound beta g^2 < 0.909 for the minimal gap
statement: The sandwich upper bound on the gap ODE beats the free A1 trap iff beta g^2 < x* ~ 0.909 (existence gate beta g^2 < 2). The density model sits two orders inside; a uniform proof along the true backward flow is missing.

name: Heat-discriminant exact-t_c ladder
statement: A rigorous non-dynamical ladder (discriminant of the heat-evolved polynomial, Dyson interval ladder) gives two-sided brackets on t_c(N) at finite N; redirected at E_coll it sharpens constants and does not cross the C_Lip/C_H wall. OLS projections of t_c (|t_c_proj| ~ 0.0071 at N = 1e4) are not bounds.

name: Volterra norm is degree-2 homogeneous in Phi
statement: V_{a,cPhi} = c^2 V_{a,Phi}, so ||V_{a,cPhi}|| = c^2 ||V_{a,Phi}|| and K_a is degree-2 homogeneous. No scalar normalisation N(c) can equate the scale-invariant cone {K_a >= 0} with the sublevel set {||V|| <= 1}; the 5000x margin is a scale artifact.

name: Volterra norm bound uses no Euler product (obstruction map P20)
statement: ||V_{a,Phi}|| <= 1 holds exactly for a <= a* in (31.6213, 31.6214) and fails above; b_a >= 0 is classical for a >= 1 and RH-equivalent over all a > 0; the positive even Davenport-Heilbronn kernel satisfies the bound.

name: Link A: Schur complement form of the Volterra bound
statement: The block operator [[I, V],[V*, I]] is positive semidefinite iff ||V|| <= 1; this is the surviving half of the refuted Section-27 two-way collapse.

name: Section-25 commutator diagonal/off-diagonal split
statement: C_a(w,z;u,v) with cosh(au) sinh(av) structure: the strict diagonal reduces to (1/2) sinh(2au) sin((wb - z)u) with sign-definite (>= 0) energy-diagonal channel; C_a is exactly antisymmetric under the joint swap, so the off-diagonal shear carries the sign question.

name: Shear mass lives at separated endpoints
statement: For nu_{a,Phi} = pushforward of Phi(u) Phi(v) sinh(a(v-u)) 1_{u<=tau<=v}: ~45% of mass at endpoint gap >= 0.1 for a <= 1, ~54% at a = 10; the diagonal-window fraction is O(eps^2). A diagonal measure sees zero shear mass; a past-future endpoint bridge is necessary.

name: Degree-0 relative operator R = Gpass^{-1/2} Gshear Gpass^{-1/2}
statement: Scale-invariant reshaping of the Section-26 object, invariant under Phi -> c Phi (tested c = 1..1000 on a 6-profile Gram). In this degree-0 measure the raw diagonal fails to dominate on about 64% of the tau range (deficit profile at U = 6, N = 200).

name: Quantised winding re-derives only Lambda >= 0
statement: The quantised winding of the supercritical-fluid picture is one topological invariant under both read-outs; in the faithful regime its conservation is equivalent to the classical de Bruijn monotonicity and gives Lambda >= 0, with no upper-bound content.

name: Route B limsup result bounds the particle flow, not Lambda
statement: The unconditional Burgers-uniformity statement controls the N-particle flow; every edge from it to a Lambda statement passes through the C_H / G6a bridge.

name: Nyman-Beurling/Baez-Duarte rate restates a zero-free half-plane (obstruction map P14)
statement: log d_N / log N -> -max(0, sigma_0 - Theta): a distance rate eta at sigma_0 is equivalent (up to eps) to zero-freeness for Re s > sigma_0 - eta. Route M Gram statistics feed this object and inherit the equivalence.

name: Binet positive-kernel representation of Stirling tails over divisors
statement: R(b) = Integral g(t) S_b(t) dt with g > 0 and S_b a Moebius divisor sum of exponentials; with 1/(12n) - 1/(360 n^3) < J(n) < 1/(12n) it gives O(1) tails on two of three omega-classes; no uniform pointwise bound on S_b(t) exists.

name: Full-precision Glaisher constant needed past dps 30
statement: Ladders using a 17-digit Glaisher literal saturate near 4.7e6 terms at dps 36; with a consistent full-precision log A the fitted cap-scaling exponent gap 0.240 vs 0.215 reduces to jitter. Numerical check rule for any Glaisher-Kinkelin based ladder.
